extras: All ink data and custom fonts are stored locally within the vault; no network requests occur during normal drawing.
intentEvidence: Draw and annotate directly on your Obsidian notes — ink lives on a separate layer above the text and follows it as your note evolves.
problem: Users need a way to add freeform visual annotations and diagrams directly onto their Markdown notes while maintaining context relative to the text.
summary: A drawing and annotation plugin that allows users to draw directly on notes, with ink anchored to text and handwriting recognition capabilities.
